title: Incidenti, detekcija, zakrpe i promjene
summary: Incident management po ISC2 (detection do lessons learned), firewalli, IDS/IPS, EDR/XDR, sandbox, honeypot, allowlisting i MSSP, zatim patch i vulnerability management (CVSS, EPSS, KEV) i change management (CAB, hitne promjene, DevOps).
summary_en: Incident management per ISC2 (from detection to lessons learned), firewalls, IDS/IPS, EDR/XDR, sandboxing, honeypots, allowlisting and MSSPs, then patch and vulnerability management (CVSS, EPSS, KEV) and change management (CAB, emergency changes, DevOps).
